self_evolution.module: jarvis/self_evolution.py (CapabilityGapDetector + SelfEvolution orchestrator + SafeEvolutionManager); instantiated and started in actions.py beside anticipation/realtime, fed user activity from actions.submit, closed on shutdown.
self_evolution.purpose: Autonomous idle-only capability expansion. Closes the discover->learn->integrate->remember->repeat loop over EXISTING subsystems rather than reimplementing them.
self_evolution.reuses: repo_learning.py (RepoLearner.search/learn + Obsidian Jarvis Repos + offline cache), repo_abilities.py (AbilityForge auto-builds abilities from a learned repo, sandboxed/validated/registered, stdlib auto-activates and third-party needs approval), repo_analysis.py, anticipation.py idle style + gpu_scheduler admission, experience/cognition stats and the deliberation ledger for gap evidence, island media_card notifications, obsidian_memory for the Improvement Backlog note.
self_evolution.adds: CapabilityGapDetector (mines cognition reliability stats, deliberation failed outcomes and repeated user requests into evidence-backed gaps), a persistent scored crash-safe Improvement Backlog (.jarvis-runtime/self-evolution/backlog.json with atomic writes and dedup against learned repos), an owned idle orchestrator thread that drives discovery->learn with per-step checkpoints, and SafeEvolutionManager for gated core self-modification.
self_evolution.idle_only: Runs only when idle_seconds have elapsed since the last user command and anticipation is not busy and RAM/CPU are within limits; any user command calls note_activity() which preempts and interrupts the in-flight step. Active user tasks always win.
self_evolution.resource_release: Heavy work (download/analysis/ability build) runs in the existing out-of-process workers which clean up; the orchestrator thread itself is lightweight and holds no model in memory. psutil gates RAM/CPU when available.
self_evolution.crash_safety: Backlog and a per-job checkpoint are durable and atomic; on restart the backlog is restored and an interrupted job resumes from pending on the next idle tick. Uncertain learning writes are never replayed; the learner/forge own their own idempotent resume.
self_evolution.self_modification: Opt-in and gated. propose -> isolate git worktree -> run the test suite -> require Actions._approve -> deploy with a kept backup -> auto-rollback on regression. Never edits security/permission/approval source (PROTECTED pattern), never auto-deploys (auto_deploy=false), never disables its own checks.
self_evolution.activation_policy: Unchanged from AbilityForge: verified stdlib-only abilities activate automatically during idle; third-party/network abilities and all core-source patches require approval.
self_evolution.long_running_service: Owned idle daemon thread inside the main process (not a separate always-on service); started/stopped with Jarvis.
self_evolution.status: 2026-10-13 IST: gap detection, scored crash-safe backlog, idle orchestration wiring and SafeEvolutionManager added and unit-tested (backlog persistence/resume, dedup, pause-on-activity, worktree test gate, approval-required deploy, rollback, protected-file refusal). `python -m jarvis.launcher --offline-check` passed with no new dependency. Live autonomous idle cycle driven end-to-end 2026-10-13 against real GitHub + the local model: detected a gap, discovered real repos, learned/understood one (17 modules, Obsidian note written), auto-triggered the forge which designed a concrete new ability ('generate slug') into the registry; the forge's code-gen + sandbox-test + activation did not finish within the ~7-minute bounded run (state 'building'), that final stage being the existing AbilityForge pipeline covered by tests.test_repo_abilities. See README dated results.

deliberation.audit_2026_10_15: Prompt09: exact unqualified proposal approval; bare refusal cancels; boolean-only per-action consent; validated finite config/opinions; risky ambiguity pauses planning; per-request brain timeout; UUID/redacted rotating ledger with categorical write diagnostics. Isolated catalog, full-regression and readiness evidence: artifacts/jarvis-audit/modules/09-deliberation/. Unknown-program mandatory research gate absent; no live account/GUI certification.
deliberation.module: jarvis/deliberation.py; wired at the task choke point in actions.execute and the feedback hook in actions.submit, with a new bounded 'deliberate' inference op in brain_worker.py and an optional approach hint threaded through brain.run
deliberation.purpose: Shared reasoning/opinion/decision layer: forms evidence-based opinions over existing systems (cognition memory/reliability, skills, capability routing), classifies risk, estimates confidence, and decides to proceed, note a recommendation, or propose-and-wait. Interprets conversational approval/rejection/delegation and keeps a traceable decision ledger.
deliberation.choke_points: Non-trivial free-form tasks only (trivial imperatives and explicit commands stay fast); not a duplicated decision loop, and all high-risk actions still funnel through the single existing Actions._approve.
deliberation.risk_tiers: low = reads/research/drafts/reversible; moderate = file/memory writes, edits, installs with backups; high = destructive/irreversible/financial/external/credential/deploy or any APPROVAL_KINDS action. Single source of truth in deliberation.classify_risk, reusing cognition.effect_of.
deliberation.autonomy: Default assertiveness 'when_it_matters': silent on simple/agreed low-risk work; voices a brief recommendation or proposes-and-waits only on genuine disagreement, ambiguity, or high risk. No new background acting; nothing executes without the existing approvals.
deliberation.store: .jarvis-runtime/deliberation/decisions.jsonl (append-only, rotated at ledger_max). Outcomes recorded from the real task result and from user approval/rejection.
deliberation.fallback: Every model call is bounded and falls back to a heuristic opinion from learned reliability and skills; deliberation never blocks or delays a turn on inference failure.
deliberation.honesty: Model claims are typed fact/assumption/prediction/preference; unknown preferences are never asserted as fact; confidence is an estimate, not proof. Uncertain actions are never replayed; recovery offers an alternative for approval rather than re-running.
deliberation.status: 2026-10-13 IST: engine, risk classification, confidence calibration, decision/feedback logic, ledger round-trip and the task/feedback wiring added and unit-tested; `python -m jarvis.launcher --offline-check` passed with no new dependency. Live end-to-end deliberation with the local qwen3.5:9b model: see README dated results.
deliberation.safety: Existing per-effect approvals remain required. Bulk destructive freeform tasks additionally pause for explicit scope approval before planning, including heuristic fallback. Decision ledger serialized. Confidence is an estimate, never permission.

rea.module: jarvis/rea_tools.py; routed via capabilities.reverse_engineer and commands.rea_command
rea.upstream: morluto/rea (REA: Reverse Engineer Anything), MIT; integrations/rea-upstream/source-manifest.json records the reviewed revision and attribution. REA source is not vendored; it is invoked as an external Node program.
rea.runtime: Caller-supplied Node.js 22.19+/24.11+/26+ plus an installed REA CLI entry (scripts/rea.mjs or published dist). Native, Android and website targets additionally need REA's own engines (Hopper/Ghidra/IDA, JADX, a Chrome-family browser); REA installs or licenses none of them.
rea.ingest: One validated target per session: an absolute local directory, an absolute local file within the configured size limit, or a public HTTPS URL. Private/loopback/reserved/credentialed destinations and symlinked or runtime-internal paths are refused. Ingest performs no fetch or analysis.
rea.execution: rea_analyze spawns the configured absolute Node executable (shell=False, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, cleared environment, telemetry disabled, bounded stdout, 10-3600s deadline) with one allowlisted REA subcommand and the session target; output is stored as untrusted evidence. No MCP protocol coupling; shim executables (.cmd/.bat/.ps1/.sh) are refused.
rea.approval: rea_analyze uses Actions._approve for the exact program and call; REA output never waives approval or authorizes further actions. No unattended analysis.
rea.clone: Best-effort functional reconstruction by the existing project-coding / LocalGithub Qwen pipeline from the ledger, proven with real tests. No byte-exact or guaranteed 1:1 clone is implied or claimed.
rea.recovery: On-demand only; not a long-running owned service and not auto-restarted. Uncertain analysis failures are never replayed; the session is inspected first.
rea.dependencies: No new Jarvis Python dependency; uses the standard library and the existing requests-based toolkit. Node and REA are caller-supplied and unmanaged by Jarvis.
rea.status: 2026-10-12 IST: bridge wiring, session/ledger lifecycle, target validation and routing added and unit-tested; `python -m jarvis.launcher --offline-check` passed. REA 6.4.0 was installed globally (npm, Node v24.14.0) and a live end-to-end run through the bridge (rea_status ready -> rea_ingest -> approved rea_analyze) statically analyzed a sample JavaScript application in ~3.8s, returning ~73KB of valid REA JSON evidence (predicate rea.javascript-application-analysis) stored in the session and ledger. A pipe-buffer deadlock in the subprocess runner was fixed by streaming stdout to a temp-file sink. Native, Android and website targets still need REA's own external engines, which were not exercised.

fast_planning.configuration: gpu_scheduler.warm_seconds and cpu_threads; brain.planner_images (auto|always|never), brain.fused_verification, brain.max_recoveries
fast_planning.inference: Primary model stays loaded for warm_seconds and uses cpu_threads for its CPU layers; each task's next-step calls form one growing conversation so the hybrid model reuses its cache (measured prompt reading 1.2-5.5 s instead of 18-24 s)
fast_planning.screenshots: Sent to the planner only for recovery, unconfirmed outcomes or windows with fewer than six readable controls; planner copies are downscaled to 1024 px
fast_planning.verification: Incremental tasks check the window change and let the next planning call judge the outcome; navigation and read-only tools skip the extra decision call; the planner's finish after a confirmed step is the goal check
fast_planning.recovery: Navigation/click failures are re-planned from fresh observation up to max_recoveries (default 5); a failed or completed action is never repeated; uncertain writes (files, commands, typing, closing apps, approval tools) still pause
fast_planning.lifecycle: No new process or service; no automatic replay of any action

conversation_and_queue.configuration: wake_timeout_seconds (call-mode listening window, default 600); suggestion_seconds (UI suggestions, default 90); context_selector.model for chat-vs-task classification
conversation_and_queue.queue: New requests wait behind running work with a spoken acknowledgement; per-task cancel tokens; cancel this task / stop all tasks / what's in the queue
conversation_and_queue.conversation: Ending a conversation (goodbye, go to sleep) stops listening without cancelling queued tasks; unrecognised speech is classified as chat or task by rules then qwen3.5:0.8b on CPU; small talk never triggers web search; saved-conversation choices only for explicit references to the past
conversation_and_queue.lifecycle: Uses the existing action and knowledge workers; the classifier runs on a short daemon thread per unrecognised utterance

Busy Python sensor isolation and 15-second stalled-read health asserted; hard native/GIL hang containment remains unresolved. No new dependency or service.
cognition_audit.runtime: Existing cognitive loop plus one owned coalescing persistence thread; no network, model, SQLite or state-file IO on tick. Tick CPU budget 250 ms, monotonic deadlines, no catch-up bursts.
cognition_audit.lifecycle: Cognition.start/close owns both threads, bounded 2-second joins per worker and at most 3 dead-writer restarts per session; Stop/Quit suppresses restarts. Health: persistence_worker_alive, persistence_worker_restarts and persistence_error in cognitive snapshot. Existing Watchdog registers persistence health/recovery and records quiet repair status; all recovery is read-only metadata, not action replay.
cognition_audit.memory: 200 percept/inbox entries with priority-preserving backpressure; 7 attention slots, deterministic salience/age ordering; goal and active task remain separate. Cached ISO parsing and vectorized NumPy decay for >=32 timestamps.
cognition_audit.confidence: Persisted local success counts drive Beta(1,1) posterior and SciPy 95% credible intervals; malformed statistics sanitized; paused tasks not successes.
cognition_audit.safety: Immutable direct reflex dispatch and compiled built-in catalog fingerprint; explicit context/Unicode-normalized cloud privacy gate; compound bulk destruction requires scope approval and ledger; durable per-target external-write uncertainty survives checkpoint truncation.

voice_input_audit.lifecycle: Existing owned capture/decoder; stop clears buffers, decoder join bounded to 2 seconds; live decoder retains ownership and blocks duplicate restart, intentional stops respected; categorical repair health and trace UUID
voice_input_audit.audio: Resample release block to 16 kHz before enqueue; reject duplicate final utterance IDs; retain explicitly repeated requests; no model, quantization or endpoint-default change
voice_input_audit.validation: Finite partial/silence intervals 0.2–5 seconds and VAD 0–1; explicit cuda/cpu device; no silent CPU fallback; typed mode available on failure
voice_input_audit.limitations: Fixture coverage only; quiet-room accuracy, background-TV false activations and long-pause acoustic tests BLOCKED pending labeled audio and dedicated GPU headroom

speech_audit.fallback: F5 missing reference/environment or startup failure before any text submission selects installed Kokoro CPU, then installed Piper; no downloads or private text replay after submission. Failed F5 stays bypassed for this Speech session. A fresh request can restart a failed owned worker.
speech_audit.ownership: Ready handshake bounded to60 seconds without holding Stop lock; worker identity binds progress; generation guards text and audio enqueue; backend changes drain earlier audio; long playback emits heartbeat; malformed frames rejected. Existing owned services only.
speech_audit.bounds: Parent64 text entries; worker64 requests with monotonic ID non-replay; Player128 pieces, mono finite<=30 seconds/piece;20,000 characters/request; pathological single words rejected before inference. EOF join5 seconds; stale audio discarded.
speech_audit.privacy: Protocol and health metadata categorical; native stderr discarded instead of appending speech.log; old private logs preserved, not published/deleted.
speech_audit.optimization: LRU16 WAV header durations, invalidated by size/mtime/ctime; no cached audio/transcript; quality parameters/model/reference unchanged.
speech_audit.limits: Human pronunciation/cloning acceptability and controlled shared STT/F5 lease arbitration remain blocked; no universal2-second speech guarantee; Qwen reserve is not a shared STT/F5 lease.
